prompts.bonanza:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: transparent raster animated game mascot pose sheet. Exactly eight complete full-body poses of ONE consistent character, laid out in four columns by two rows on a square 1600x1600 canvas. Each invisible cell is portrait 400x800. No background.
Style: finished 2D game character illustration, controlled dark ink outlines and broad painted shading, expressive strong silhouette, restrained surface detail. NOT vector icons, photoreal people, glossy 3D renders or ornamental fantasy costume.
Layout MUST be precise: put each entire character including head, BOTH arms, BOTH hands, both feet and all accessories inside its own cell, within the central 72% width and central 76% height. All feet share the same baseline at 88% of cell height. Nothing crosses grid borders. Large totally transparent gutters. Same character scale, costume, face and lighting in every pose, no detached body parts, no extra character, props or furniture.
Poses in row-major order, eight exactly:
0 idle: relaxed standing neutral looking at viewer, arms resting.
1 idle variation: same neutral with a small head tilt and shoulders settled; the mask itself does not morph.
2 watch: anticipatory lean with head and one hand gesturing toward the viewer's right.
3 bonus: delighted open hands toward viewer's right, compact elbows inside cell.
4 win: playful celebration dance with one hand raised and one knee slightly lifted.
5 second win: alternate dance beat with the other hand raised and other knee slightly lifted; same silhouette scale.
6 loss: small teasing shrug/head tilt, palms up inside cell.
7 laugh: one hand near mask mouth with shoulders slightly raised, mischievous but friendly.
No words, frame labels, grid outlines, decorative particles, glow, ground planes or floor shadows. The image is genuinely transparent RGBA. The reference environment guides only color/lighting; do not put it inside any cell.
Character: a friendly anonymous night-garden merchant. Draw the supplied original Minecraft black hooded skin as the base character, including its recognizable pixel Anonymous face, square head, standard slim 3-pixel arm proportions and block-shaped hands/feet. Render it as stylish PAINTED 2D game art, not a procedural cube model. Add only a simple forest-green gardening apron over the original black outfit and one small painted apple badge on its pocket. Keep original skin identity/hood, no human face. Warm lamp light from upper left and a faint cyan night rim from the right. No ornate gold embroidery. The eight poses show the same intact merchant.
